statement: For the rank97 free kernel N over Q of order576, exact characteristic class-two quotients have orders576*3^4753 and576*2^4850. Complete correction and lower-conjugator calculations prove that every one of the23 nonidentity selected D.25 actions has no genuine full profinite lift. A different homology correction for the same extra CM pair A=I, beta=(9,8;4,9) passes both class-two tests, has kernel rank97 and an explicitly verified470844-letter cusp word. It extends to an actual automorphism of H2 times_Q P3, retaining the entire free pro3 kernel, and gives compatible nonarithmetical finite shadows after one cusp gauge.
depends_on: exact free-group Magnus and class-two normal forms proved in D.27
notes: At3 the4656-dimensional central layer has Reynolds image135, correction rank127, and rank130 after all34 lower r-centralizer directions; four selected actions survive. At2 the4753-dimensional central layer has correction rank4737, rank4738 after the multiplier, and rank4748 after all52 lower s-centralizer directions; two selected actions survive. The intersection is identity only, and the original Herfort-Ribes torsion theorem makes these conjugacy tests necessary for a genuine full lift. The alternate witness changes the initial mod2 homology action in a98-dimensional affine space: five exact quadratic obstructions vanish at trial48, rank97 holds, multiplier is1, and the complete corrected word is directly checked. It retains the original mod3 identity action and hence extends to H2 times_Q P3 by coprime centralizer lifting. Genuineness of that alternate witness and the full CM pair remains undecided. No complete exclusion of the CM coset is claimed. Original selected certificates are preserved separately. Agent A independently audited and reran all three programs. D.30 subsequently proves this particular recorded H2 representative nongenuine when its retained G6 data are fixed, and constructs a further explicit central replacement with the same homology masks.
